name: PHD-Hand
summary: A 3D-printed (TPU/PETG) linkage-driven hand that costs under US$650 in parts. Each digit has three actuated degrees of freedom: a two-axis flexure knuckle plus a crossed four-bar that couples the top two joints at a 0.77 ratio, close to the human finger. Fifteen hobby servos run from one controller. Reported failures in about 200 test hours were two broken coupling rods.

sources.title: NJIT's PHD-Hand Uses Linkages, Not Tendons — Humanoids Daily
